en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a panoramic view of a large European public square lined with multi‑storey historic buildings, trees, pedestrians and horse‑drawn vehicles. The foreground includes a landscaped area and a monument. On the picture side, the captions read "Pécs" and "Széchenyi-tér". The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, an address, and an 8 fillér Hungarian postage stamp postmarked in Pécs. The card is printed with the publisher mark "Barasits Budapest".
